    input j,
    input k,
    output reg Q
);

            2'b00: Q <= Q;   // hold state (Qold unchanged)

module TopModule (
    input  logic in,
    input  logic [1:0] state,
    output logic [1:0] next_state,
    output logic out
);

    always_comb begin
        case (state)
            2'b00: begin // State A
                next_state = in ? 2'b01 : 2'b00; // A -> A (in=0), A -> B (in=1)
                out        = 1'b0;
            end
            2'b01: begin // State B
                next_state = in ? 2'b01 : 2'b10; // B -> C (in=0), B -> B (in=1)
                out        = 1'b0;
            end
            2'b10: begin // State C
                next_state = in ? 2'b11 : 2'b00; // C -> D (in=1), C -> A (in=0)
                out        = 1'b0;
            end
            2'b11: begin // State D
                next_state = in ? 2'b01 : 2'b10; // D -> B (in=1), D -> C (in=0)
                out        = 1'b1;
            end
            default: begin
                next_state = 2'b00;
                out        = 1'b0;
            end
        endcase
    end

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input  logic clk,
    input  logic reset,
    input  logic j,
    input  logic k,
    output logic out
);

// State encoding: 0 = OFF, 1 = ON
logic state, next_state;

// Next-state logic (Moore machine)
always_comb begin
    if (reset == 1'b1) begin
        next_state = 1'b0;      // synchronous reset forces OFF
    end else begin
        case (state)
            1'b0: begin           // current state OFF
                if (j == 1'b1)
                    next_state = 1'b1;   // j=1 → transition to ON
                else
                    next_state = 1'b0;   // j=0 → stay OFF
            end
            1'b1: begin           // current state ON
                if (k == 1'b1)
                    next_state = 1'b0;   // k=1 → transition to OFF
                else
                    next_state = 1'b1;   // k=0 → stay ON
            end
            default: next_state = 1'b0;
        endcase
    end
end

// State flip-flops with synchronous active-high reset
always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset)
        state <= 1'b0;      // reset to OFF
    else
        state <= next_state;
end

// Output logic (Moore: output depends only on state)
assign out = state;   // out = 1 when state = ON, else 0

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  reset,
    input  w,
    output z
);

// State register (3 bits to encode 6 states)
reg [2:0] state_reg;

// Next-state logic (state table)
reg [2:0] next_state;

always @(*) begin
    case (state_reg)
        3'b000: // State A
            next_state = (w) ? 3'b001 : 3'b000; // A --1--> B, A --0--> A
        3'b001: // State B
            next_state = (w) ? 3'b010 : 3'b011; // B --1--> C, B --0--> D
        3'b010: // State C
            next_state = (w) ? 3'b100 : 3'b011; // C --1--> E, C --0--> D
        3'b011: // State D
            next_state = (w) ? 3'b101 : 3'b000; // D --1--> F, D --0--> A
        3'b100: // State E
            next_state = (w) ? 3'b100 : 3'b011; // E --1--> E, E --0--> D
        3'b101: // State F
            next_state = (w) ? 3'b010 : 3'b011; // F --1--> C, F --0--> D
        default: next_state = 3'b000;
    endcase
end

// State flip-flops (synchronous positive-edge triggered, active-high reset)
always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset)
        state_reg <= 3'b000;   // Reset to state A
    else
        state_reg <= next_state;
end

// Output z: 1 for states E and F, 0 for states A–D
assign z = state_reg[2];  // MSB of state encoding

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input  logic clk,
    input  logic reset,
    input  logic w,
    output logic z
);

// one-hot state encoding:
// bit 0 = A, bit 1 = B, bit 2 = C, bit 3 = D, bit 4 = E, bit 5 = F
logic [5:0] state, next_state;

// next state logic (Moore machine: output z is 1 when in state E or F)
always_comb begin
    case (state)
        6'b000001: // A
            next_state = w ? 6'b000001 : 6'b000010; // w=1 -> A, w=0 -> B
        6'b000010: // B
            next_state = w ? 6'b001000 : 6'b000100; // w=1 -> D, w=0 -> C
        6'b000100: // C
            next_state = w ? 6'b001000 : 6'b010000; // w=1 -> D, w=0 -> E
        6'b001000: // D
            next_state = w ? 6'b000001 : 6'b100000; // w=1 -> A, w=0 -> F
        6'b010000: // E
            next_state = w ? 6'b001000 : 6'b010000; // w=1 -> D, w=0 -> E
        6'b100000: // F
            next_state = w ? 6'b001000 : 6'b000100; // w=1 -> D, w=0 -> C
        default: next_state = 6'b000001; // fallback
    endcase
end

// state flip-flops, positive edge-triggered, asynchronous active-high reset
always_ff @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset)
        state <= 6'b000001; // reset to state A
    else
        state <= next_state;
end

// output logic: z = 1 when in state E or F (Moore output)
assign z = state[4] | state[5];

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  load,
    input  ena,
    input  [1:0] amount,
    input  [63:0] data,
    output [63:0] q
);

    reg [63:0] q_reg;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (load) begin
            // Load the shift register with the data input
            q_reg <= data;
        end else if (ena) begin
            // Shift operation selected by 'amount'
            case (amount)
                2'b00: q_reg <= {q_reg[62:0], 1'b0};       // shift left 1 bit
                2'b01: q_reg <= {q_reg[55:0], 8'b0};       // shift left 8 bits
                2'b10: q_reg <= {q_reg[63], q_reg[63:1]};  // arithmetic right shift 1 bit
                2'b11: q_reg <= {{8{q_reg[63]}}, q_reg[63:8]}; // arithmetic right shift 8 bits
                default: q_reg <= q_reg;                   // hold (should not occur)
            endcase
        end
        // If neither load nor ena is active, q_reg holds its previous value
    end

    assign q = q_reg;

endmodule

Prob152_lemmings3.code:
module TopModule(
    input clk,
    input areset,
    input bump_left,
    input bump_right,
    input ground,
    input dig,
    output walk_left,
    output walk_right,
    output aaah,
    output digging
);

    // State encoding (Moore machine)
    parameter S_WL = 3'b000; // walking left
    parameter S_WR = 3'b001; // walking right
    parameter S_FL = 3'b010; // falling (was going left)
    parameter S_FR = 3'b011; // falling (was going right)
    parameter S_DL = 3'b100; // digging (was going left)
    parameter S_DR = 3'b101; // digging (was going right)

    reg [2:0] state, next_state;

    // Sequential logic: positive edge triggered, async reset to walk left
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (areset)
            state <= S_WL;
        else
            state <= next_state;
    end

    // Combinational next-state logic
    always @(*) begin
        next_state = state; // default: stay in current state
        case (state)
            S_WL: begin
                if (~ground) next_state = S_FL;        // fall has highest precedence
                else if (dig) next_state = S_DL;       // dig has higher precedence than switch
                else if (bump_left) next_state = S_WR; // bump left -> walk right
                else if (bump_right) next_state = S_WL;// bump right -> walk left (same direction)
            end
            S_WR: begin
                if (~ground) next_state = S_FR;        // fall has highest precedence
                else if (dig) next_state = S_DR;       // dig has higher precedence than switch
                else if (bump_right) next_state = S_WL;// bump right -> walk left (switch)
                else if (bump_left) next_state = S_WR; // bump left -> walk right (same direction)
            end
            S_FL: begin
                if (ground) next_state = S_WL;         // ground reappears -> resume walking left
                else next_state = S_FL;                // continue falling
            end
            S_FR: begin
                if (ground) next_state = S_WR;         // ground reappears -> resume walking right
                else next_state = S_FR;                // continue falling
            end
            S_DL: begin
                if (~ground) next_state = S_FL;        // reached other side -> fall (remember left direction)
                else next_state = S_DL;                // continue digging
            end
            S_DR: begin
                if (~ground) next_state = S_FR;        // reached other side -> fall (remember right direction)
                else next_state = S_DR;                // continue digging
            end
            default: next_state = S_WL;
        endcase
    end

    // Output logic (Moore: outputs depend only on current state)
    assign walk_left = (state == S_WL);
    assign walk_right = (state == S_WR);
    assign aaah = (state == S_FL) | (state == S_FR);
    assign digging = (state == S_DL) | (state == S_DR);

endmodule
